thesis: The 4.6x volume signal lacks a confirmed operating catalyst, while fiscal Q1 2027 results remain a binary event scheduled for September 9. Although fiscal 2026 finished with 8.0% Q4 rental-revenue growth, $2.055 billion of free cash flow, active repurchases, and ample liquidity, those positives do not justify a fresh entry before the report because adjusted/non-GAAP EBITDA margin fell year over year and the issuer completed a 2026 balance-sheet-classification restatement. The later remediation of the related material weakness does not erase the completed event; governance_history therefore mechanically forces low conviction. Avoid pending operating proof.
invalidation: Reassess after September 9 if reported Q1 rental-revenue growth is consistent with the issuer's 5%-8% fiscal 2027 outlook, the year-over-year adjusted/non-GAAP EBITDA-margin decline materially narrows on a comparable basis, guidance is maintained or raised, and no new material weakness is disclosed.
sources: Sunbelt Rentals fiscal Q1 2027 event announcement: https://ir.sunbeltrentals.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/151/sunbelt-rentals-to-announce-first-quarter-fiscal-year-2027-results-on-september-9-2026

thesis: Samsara's confirmed Q2 fiscal 2027 release supports a long: revenue and ARR each grew 30% year over year, net new ARR grew 28%, large-customer ARR expanded, the issuer reported diluted EPS of $0.03 under U.S. GAAP, free cash flow was positive, and full-year revenue guidance increased. The strongest counter-evidence is that Q3 revenue-growth guidance slows to 24% and non-GAAP operating margin excludes substantial stock-compensation charges; this does not overturn the positive read because full-year guidance rose and ARR growth remained durable, but it makes deceleration and dilution economics explicit monitoring items. Motive's active case has a court-scheduled November 14 expert-discovery compliance deadline, so active_litigation mechanically forces low conviction.
invalidation: Invalidate the long if Samsara lowers the September 3 fiscal 2027 revenue floor below $2.043 billion, withdraws its U.S.-GAAP-profitable outlook, or reports ARR growth below 25% year over year at the next release.
sources: Samsara SEC-filed Q2 fiscal 2027 earnings release: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1642896/000162828026060438/samsaraepr-q22027.htm
Motive Technologies v. Samsara case schedule: https://ipverse.greyb.com/litigations/motive-technologies-inc-v-samsara-inc--cand--3-24-cv-00902

thesis: Guidewire's confirmed fiscal 2026 results were strong, but the fiscal 2027 revenue outlook midpoint implies roughly 16% growth after 23% growth in fiscal 2026, and the fiscal Q1 revenue range points to slower near-term conversion; today's sharp, high-volume repricing therefore argues against initiating before conversion evidence improves. The strongest counter-evidence is 19% constant-currency ARR growth, 22% fully ramped ARR growth, record sales activity, low gross attrition, and higher operating-cash-flow guidance. Those strengths do not reverse the avoid read because the immediate company outlook itself shows a slower realization path after elevated expectations. An active employment case has an October 6 mediation hearing, so active_litigation mechanically forces low conviction.
invalidation: Reverse the avoid thesis if a subsequent issuer report shows fiscal Q1 revenue above the $378 million guidance ceiling, raises fiscal 2027 ending ARR above $1.460 billion, and supplies evidence that backlog-to-ARR conversion has reaccelerated; remove the litigation flag only if the October hearing is vacated or the case is resolved.
sources: Guidewire fiscal Q4 and fiscal 2026 earnings release: https://guidewire.gcs-web.com/news-releases/news-release-details/guidewire-announces-fourth-quarter-and-fiscal-year-2026

thesis: Docusign's confirmed Q2 fiscal 2027 release supports a long: revenue grew 9%, Intelligent Agreement Management expanded to 15.1% of ARR from 12.6% one quarter earlier, free-cash-flow margin reached 34%, share repurchases continued, and management raised full-year revenue and ARR expectations. The strongest counter-evidence is that about 1.3 percentage points of revenue growth came from foreign exchange and non-GAAP gross margin declined slightly year over year; it does not overturn the read because IAM mix, cash generation, and the raised company outlook improved together. Hart v. Docusign remains active with a September 15 case-management conference despite a magistrate's dismissal recommendation, so active_litigation mechanically forces low conviction.
invalidation: Invalidate the long if Docusign cuts fiscal 2027 ARR growth below 8.5%, lowers its stated fiscal Q4 IAM share objective below 18%, or the district court rejects dismissal in Hart and the case develops into a material operating exposure.

thesis: Victoria's Secret's confirmed Q2 2026 release showed 10% net-sales growth, 9% comparable-sales growth, $124 million of adjusted/non-GAAP operating income excluding the tariff-refund benefit, and higher full-year sales and adjusted/non-GAAP operating-income guidance. The strongest positive counter to an avoid is that this is credible turnaround evidence rather than a purely technical move. It does not resolve the entry case because the fiscal Q3 operating-income outlook is only $10-$20 million while management is increasing marketing investment and still navigating tariff uncertainty, leaving the durability of the Q2 step-up unsettled. A brand-management affiliate faces an active TCPA case with a September 15 case-management conference, so active_litigation independently forces low conviction.
invalidation: Invalidate the avoid if fiscal Q3 reported operating income exceeds the issuer's $20 million guidance ceiling, sales meet or exceed the $1.600 billion guidance ceiling, full-year adjusted/non-GAAP operating-income guidance rises again, and the September litigation conference produces no material escalation.
sources: Minter v. Victoria's Secret Direct Brand Management public docket: https://dockets.justia.com/docket/california/candce/4%3A2026cv04654/470288
